$description: Two faces. Pixel Bop, Blip's own pixel font, for big text: always on the grid, always capitals. Pixelify Sans for UI and body text: the one thing allowed off the grid, because a 7-pixel font is too small to read at body sizes.

display.$description: Pixel Bop, in Latin, Cyrillic and Greek. Sized in whole scales: 1 em is 10 pixels, caps are 7 pixels tall. Then Pixelify Sans, emoji sized to the capitals (Blip Fallback, in @jaatster/blip-font) and the system font for other scripts.

ui.$description: Pixelify Sans, a variable font from 400 to 700, in Latin, Cyrillic and Greek. Its grid is 11 pixels to the em, so at 22 px its pixels are Blip pixels. Then emoji sized to its capitals (Blip Fallback, in @jaatster/blip-font) and the system font for other scripts.

display-scale.$description: Pixel Bop sizes, as whole scales of the pixel. Font size = 10 x pixel x scale; cap height = 7 x pixel x scale.

size.$description: Pixelify Sans sizes, in rem: 12, 14, 16, 18 and 22 px at the browser's default text size (16 px), and larger when the person sets a larger default. Not tied to the pixel size, so text stays readable when the pixel grows.

title.$description: 22 px at the default, where Pixelify's pixels land on the 2 px grid.

display-loose.$description: Stacked display lines with accented capitals.
